targets.expected_type: ∀ p q : ℝ × ℝ, value (addPair p q) = value p + value q
∀ (c : ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ), value (scalePair c p) = c * value p
∀ p q : ℝ × ℝ, value (mulPair p q) = value p * value q
∀ {E : Type u} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [Preorder E] {s : Set E}, Convex ℝ s → ∀ c : ℝ, Regular s (fun _ : E => constPair c)
∀ {E : Type u} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [Preorder E] {s : Set E}, ∀ {f : E → ℝ × ℝ}, Regular s f → ∀ c : ℝ, Regular s (fun x => scalePair c (f x))
∀ {E : Type u} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [Preorder E] {s : Set E}, ∀ {f g : E → ℝ × ℝ}, Regular s f → Regular s g → Regular s (fun x => mulPair (f x) (g x))
∀ {E : Type u} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [Preorder E] {s : Set E}, ∀ {ι : Type v} (t : Finset ι) (f : ι → E → ℝ × ℝ), Convex ℝ s → (∀ i ∈ t, Regular s (f i)) → Regular s (fun x => ∑ i ∈ t, f i x)

∀ {E : Type u} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [Preorder E] {s : Set E}, ∀ {f : E → ℝ × ℝ}, Regular s f → ∀ φ : (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ × ℝ, ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun z => (φ z).1) → ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun z => (φ z).2) → Monotone φ → (∀ z, 0 ≤ z → 0 ≤ φ z) → Regular s (fun x => φ (f x))

∀ {E : Type u} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [Preorder E] {s : Set E}, ∀ {ι : Type v} (φ : ((ι → ℝ) × (ι → ℝ)) → ℝ × ℝ), ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun z => (φ z).1) → ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun z => (φ z).2) → Monotone φ → (∀ z, 0 ≤ z → 0 ≤ φ z) → Convex ℝ s → ∀ f : ι → E → ℝ × ℝ, (∀ i, Regular s (f i)) → Regular s (fun x => φ ((fun i => (f i x).1), (fun i => (f i x).2)))
